script_text: Taurus, earth sign, Venus holds the pen this week—and she's rewriting your story. Monday and Tuesday, the Sun opposes Uranus in your 7th House, bringing sudden partnership news or a romantic confession. Venus in Libra also boosts your income. Wednesday is your power day: Venus trines Pluto in your 6th House, perfect for career pitches. Thursday, the Sun enters your 8th House, shifting focus to shared resources and inner transformation. This weekend, Mars squares Saturn in your 7th House—avoid power struggles. Sunday, Mercury sextiles Venus, ideal for a heart-to-heart. Friday, Jupiter trines your Sun, bringing a surprise career opportunity. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines Pluto in your 6th House. Worst day: Saturday, when Mars squares Saturn, triggering conflict. Avoid signing contracts on Saturday. Use Wednesday's Venus-Pluto trine to negotiate your worth. Be patient. Stay grounded. Follow for daily cosmic updates.
